record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: If Θ is the set of irrational rotation numbers θ for which H2 has a Herman ring of rotation number θ, does Θ have positive Lebesgue measure, and more precisely is 0 a Lebesgue density point of Θ?

evidence.quote: Question 18. — Does Θ have positive Lebesgue measure? More precisely, is 0 a Lebesgue density point of Θ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the complex Hénon map of degree 2 defined by
\[ H_2 : \mathbb{C}^2 \to \mathbb{C}^2, \qquad H_2(x,y) = (x^2 + c - a y,\; x), \]
with parameters $a \in \mathbb{C}^*$ and $c \in \mathbb{C}$. A Herman ring of $H_2$ is an invariant Fatou component on which $H_2$ acts as an irrational rotation; more precisely, it is a $H_2$-invariant open subset $U \subset \mathbb{C}^2$ biholomorphic to an annulus $\{z \in \mathbb{C} : 1 < |z| < R\}$ (for some $R > 1$) such that, in suitable holomorphic coordinates on $U$, the map $H_2|_U$ becomes the rotation $z \mapsto e^{2\pi i \theta} z$ with $\theta \in \mathbb{R} \setminus \mathbb{Q}$; the number $\theta \pmod 1$ is called the rotation number of the Herman ring.

Let
\[ \Theta = \{ \theta \in (\mathbb{R}\setminus\mathbb{Q})/\mathbb{Z} : \text{there exist parameters } (a,c) \text{ such that } H_2 \text{ admits a Herman ring of rotation number } \theta \}. \]

Determine whether $\Theta$ has positive Lebesgue measure in $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$, and more precisely, whether $0$ is a Lebesgue density point of $\Theta$ (i.e. whether
\[ \lim_{r \to 0^+} \frac{m(\Theta \cap (-r,r))}{2r} = 1, \]
where $m$ denotes Lebesgue measure).
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the set Θ of rotation numbers of Herman rings of quadratic complex Hénon maps has positive Lebesgue measure, and whether 0 is a Lebesgue density point of Θ, is listed as an open problem in the dynamics community. Related results exist for Hénon maps of degree 3 (a positive-measure set of invariant analytic circles with bounded-type rotation numbers), but the case of H₂ remains unresolved.
